name: MongoDB Atlas Overview
description: Operations, latency, connections, replication, resources, disk and database size for Atlas clusters.

panels.name: Clusters reporting
panels.description: Dedicated (M10+) clusters with cluster metrics turned on.

panels.name: Operations
panels.description: Query, insert, update and delete operations across the selected clusters.

panels.name: Operations by cluster
panels.description: Query operations per second.

panels.name: Connections used
panels.description: Of the cluster tier's connection limit.

panels.name: Read / write execution time
panels.description: Average time per operation, highest node per cluster.

panels.name: Query targeting (scanned / returned)
panels.description: High values mean queries scan far more than they return; check indexes.

panels.name: Read / write tickets available
panels.description: WiredTiger concurrency tickets. Near zero means queuing.

panels.name: Largest databases (data size)
panels.description: Needs database metrics on the integration.

panels.name: Documents returned / inserted / updated / deleted
panels.description: Needs the Expanded metric tier on the integration account. Panels stay empty on the default Core tier.
